author: Insta360
description:
This Shark Awareness Week, we're showing how every diver can contribute to shark conservation through the PADI AWARE Global Shark & Ray Census 🦈 Every sighting becomes valuable data that helps protect vulnerable species, deepen our understanding of ocean health, and inform conservation efforts around the world.

Join the movement at action.padiaware.org, and stay tuned for the full video on July 10.
